answer: Inter-arrival Fable Window. Each identity must sustain a traffic shape whose inter-request timing fits a per-agent envelope; deviations decay a hidden reputation score toward a vertex threshold below which routing priority drops. An attacker spinning up many identities must either emulate plausible human-paced timing across all of them or accept slow decay, costing sustained coordination and per-identity babysitting effort. A small ember of genuine activity resets decay only gradually, so bursts are punished.
